policy: No scraping or bulk reuse of Wikiloc/Komoot content. Use official share pages and user-authorized GPS files. OpenStreetMap trail data is separately licensed under ODbL and requires attribution.

providers.name: Wikiloc
providers.notes: No public developer API. Open route pages through Wikiloc; user can download GPX/TCX where permitted and import their own file.

providers.name: komoot
providers.notes: No public API. Supports importing/exporting individual GPS files including GPX; exports may require the starting region to be unlocked.

providers.name: OpenStreetMap
providers.notes: Open trail/path data under ODbL; respect attribution, API/provider usage policies and license obligations.

providers.name: Mapy.com
providers.notes: External route planning/navigation service; use share links or user-exported tracks, not scraping.

providers.name: AllTrails
providers.notes: External trail discovery; use its own sharing/export permissions.
